title: Estimates of the Heritability of Human Longevity Are Substantially Inflated due to Assortative Mating.
phenotype_definition: lifespan (age at death) in relatives incl. in-laws
n_controls_or_total: hundreds of millions of historical persons (Ancestry public trees)
ancestry: not stated (Ancestry.com public pedigrees; birth cohorts 1800s-early 1900s)
key_loci: none (heritability study)
replication_status: consistent with Kaplanis 2018 order of magnitude
notes: True h2 of longevity well below 10% after accounting for assortative mating; nominal 15-30% estimates inflated by in-law correlation.

title: Quantitative analysis of population-scale family trees with millions of relatives.
n_controls_or_total: 86 million profiles; ~130,000 parent-child trios for mid-parent h2
key_loci: none (heritability study)
notes: Full text read = bioRxiv preprint copy: h2(mid-parent)=12.2% (s.e. 0.4%); h2 from sex-concordant relatives 16.1%; dominance ~4%. Published Science version numbers not re-checked.

title: Heritability of intrinsic human life span is about 50% when confounding factors are addressed.
design: twin modelling (Gompertz-Makeham correlated frailty; twins reared together/apart)
n_controls_or_total: Scandinavian twin cohorts (n not in abstract)
ancestry: Scandinavian twin cohorts (as described by Kornilov 2026; not checked in paper)
key_loci: none (heritability study)
notes: Abstract: heritability of life span due to intrinsic mortality >50% (title: ~50%); contrasts twin 20-25% and pedigree ~6%. Not OA; full text not read.

title: Misclassification of heritable mortality undermines estimates of intrinsic life span heritability
key_loci: none
notes: Argues infection/accident deaths are themselves heritable, so removing extrinsic mortality inflates h2 (reports Shenhar figure as ~55%). No PMID.

title: Omitted familial extrinsic risk inflates inferred intrinsic lifespan heritability
key_loci: none
notes: Omitting heritable extrinsic susceptibility inflates Falconer h2 by +2.8 to +18.9 pp (mean ~9 pp) in the Shenhar framework. No PMID.

title: Integrating the environmental and genetic architectures of aging and mortality.
phenotype_definition: all-cause mortality; proteomic age clock; incident disease
key_loci: PRS for 22 diseases (no single loci)
notes: Beyond age+sex, PRS for 22 diseases add <2 percentage points of mortality variation vs +17 pp for 25 exposome factors; PRS dominate for dementias and breast/prostate/colorectal cancer (10.3-26.2%).

title: Genetic predisposition, modifiable lifestyles, and their joint effects on human lifespan: evidence from multiple cohort studies.
key_loci: lifespan PRS (quintiles)
replication_status: validated across cohorts per title (not checked)
notes: HR death short- vs long-lifespan PRS 1.21 (1.16-1.26); unfavourable vs favourable lifestyle 1.78 (1.71-1.85); both 2.04 (1.87-2.22); no multiplicative interaction (p=0.10). Venue is BMJ Evidence-Based Medicine (not BMJ Open).

title: Trans-biobank analysis with 676,000 individuals elucidates the association of polygenic risk scores of complex traits with human lifespan.
key_loci: SBP PRS; BMI PRS
notes: High SBP PRS: HR 1.03 (1.02-1.04) for shorter lifespan, P=3.9e-13; parental lifespan HR 1.06. BMI PRS effect differs Japanese vs European (P_het=9.5e-8). Ancestry-specific finding.

title: Human longevity: 25 genetic loci associated in 389,166 UK biobank participants.
phenotype_definition: parental attained age; top-10% parental survival
key_loci: 10 loci combined parents; sex-specific loci (3 mother-only, 8 father-only); MC2R for top 10%
replication_status: GRS replicated in HRS and Wisconsin Longitudinal Study
notes: Early evidence for sex-specific routes to longevity.

title: Genomics of 1 million parent lifespans implicates novel pathways and common diseases and distinguishes survival chances.
phenotype_definition: parental lifespan (Cox, years of life per allele)
n_controls_or_total: 1,012,240 parents (512,047 mothers, 500,193 fathers) per Timmers 2020 methods
key_loci: see candidate CSV (APOE, CHRNA3/5-HYKK, LPA, ATXN2/SH2B3, CDKN2B-AS1, FURIN, HLA-DQA1, HTT, KCNK3, MAGI3, LDLR, HP) || candidates: APOE:rs429358:T:1.0561:3e-83; HYKK/CHRNA3/CHRNA5:rs8042849:T:0.4368:2e-26; LPA:rs10455872:A:0.7639:9e-25; ATXN2/SH2B3:rs11065979:C:0.2798:1e-12; CDKN2B-AS1:rs1556516:G:0.251:7e-11; FURIN:rs6224:G:0.2507:1e-10; HLA-DQA1/HLA-DRB1:rs34967069:T:0.5613:4e-09; HTT:rs61348208:T:0.2299:6e-09; KCNK3:rs1275922:G:0.2579:6e-09; MAGI3:rs1230666:G:0.3224:6e-09; LDLR/SMARCA4:rs142158911:A:0.355:8e-09; HP/DHODH:rs12924886:A:0.2798:1e-08
notes: Polygenic score spans ~5 years of life between top and bottom deciles. Dementia, CVD and lung-cancer/smoking variants explain most variance.

title: Multivariate genomic scan implicates novel loci and haem metabolism in human ageing.
n_controls_or_total: healthspan 300,477; parental lifespan 1,012,240 parents; longevity 11,262 cases / 25,483 controls
key_loci: 10 loci acting on all 3 traits: SLC4A7, LINC02513, FOXO3, ZW10, FGD6, LPA, CDKN2B-AS1, TOX3, LDLR, APOE (Table 1; A1 = allele increasing all three) || candidates: SLC4A7:rs2643826:C:0.017:4e-08; LINC02513:rs17499404:A:0.012:4e-08; FOXO3:rs1159806:T:0.015:1e-08; ZW10:rs61905747:A:0.024:4e-10; FGD6:rs12830425:G:0.032:8e-09; CDKN2B-AS1:rs7859727:C:0.025:4e-18; TOX3:rs4783780:A:0.014:1e-08; LDLR:rs6511720:T:0.034:4e-09
replication_status: nominal significance in each of 3 input datasets; 5 loci new
notes: Best single source for a healthspan+lifespan pleiotropic sub-panel. FOXO3 lead rs1159806 in moderate LD (r2>0.4) with v1 rs2802292.

title: Identification of 12 genetic loci associated with human healthspan.
phenotype_definition: end of healthspan = first of major chronic diseases/death
key_loci: 12 loci incl. TCF7L2, IRF4, TYR, DEF8, HLA, LPA, CDKN2B-AS1 (Table 2, beta=log HR) || candidates: TCF7L2:rs34872471:C:0.061:9.73e-29; IRF4:rs12203592:T:0.063:1.80e-25; TYR:rs1126809:A:0.04:2.35e-13; DEF8:rs4268748:C:0.038:1.55e-12; NR (chr2:202,204,741 as printed in Zenin Table 2):rs10197246:C:-0.033:3.67e-09
replication_status: partial: several loci replicated; some not
notes: Pigmentation loci (IRF4, TYR, DEF8/MC1R) probably act via skin cancer; population-specific (UK).

title: A meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies identifies multiple longevity genes.
replication_status: APOE robustly replicated; GPR78 single study
notes: Strict longevity phenotype definition; key anchor for "longevity" tier.

title: Multivariate genome-wide analysis of aging-related traits identifies novel loci and new drug targets for healthy aging.
phenotype_definition: latent "mvAge" factor from healthspan, lifespan, longevity, frailty, epigenetic ageing
key_loci: 52 variants / 38 loci (top: TOMM40/APOE, LPA, CDKN2B-AS1, TCF7L2, SLC22A3); sign convention of mvAge not checked
notes: Drug-target MR: metformin targets P=8.41e-5, thiazolidinediones P=3.50e-10, PCSK9 inhibition P=1.62e-6, ANGPTL4, beta-blockers, CCBs beneficial.

title: Germline burden of rare damaging variants negatively affects human healthspan and lifespan.
n_controls_or_total: two large cohorts (n not in abstract)
key_loci: burden of rarest protein-truncating variants
notes: Rare PTV burden accounts for 0.4 (healthspan) and 1.3 (lifespan) years of variability.

title: Sex Differences in Genetic Associations With Longevity.
key_loci: 11 male- and 11 female-specific loci (P<1e-5); ABCG2 rs2622624 female-specific (replicated in European women P=.003)
notes: Sex-specific longevity loci; suggestive thresholds only.

title: Novel loci and pathways significantly associated with longevity.
key_loci: IL6 rs2069837 (GWS); ANKRD20A9P rs2440012; APOE, 5q33.3 replicated || candidates: IL6:rs2069837:A:1.6393442:2e-09
replication_status: IL6 rs2069837 also at GWS in European Deelen 2019 (GWAS Catalog)
notes: Cross-ancestry replication of IL6 rs2069837 makes it a strong NEW candidate (v1 has only IL6 rs1800795).

title: GWAS of epigenetic aging rates in blood reveals a critical role for TERT.
phenotype_definition: intrinsic (IEAA) and extrinsic (EEAA) epigenetic age acceleration (Horvath/Hannum)
key_loci: 5 IEAA loci incl. TERT, KIF13A/NHLRC1; 3 EEAA loci || candidates: TERT:rs2736099:A:0.631:1e-12
notes: TERT variants that lengthen LTL paradoxically raise IEAA; MR: menarche/menopause and lipoproteins affect IEAA.

title: A meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies of epigenetic age acceleration.
key_loci: 10 Horvath-EAA SNPs (TPMT, NHLRC1, TERT...), 1 Hannum-EAA SNP rs1005277
notes: Hannum-EAA more environment-sensitive than Horvath-EAA.

title: Genome-wide association studies identify 137 genetic loci for DNA methylation biomarkers of aging.
phenotype_definition: GrimAge, PhenoAge, Hannum, Horvath(IEAA) acceleration; DNAm granulocytes, DNAm PAI-1
key_loci: 137 loci (113 novel); top: CREB3L3 (PhenoAge), NHLRC1 (IEAA), F2RL3/SIN3B (GrimAge) || candidates: F2RL3/SIN3B:rs2227341:G:-1.3482:6e-25; CREB3L3:rs73538174:A:-3.2457:6e-69; NHLRC1:rs10949481:T:-1.0823:4e-54; BLNK/DNTT:rs941997:T:-0.3481:9e-22
replication_status: largest clock GWAS to date (as found); 21/137 replicated in Taiwan (Lin 2022)
notes: GrimAge PGS associated with adiposity, education, parental longevity, CRP. Some clock loci may be mQTLs of clock CpGs; interpret as biomarker loci, not lifespan loci.

title: Genome-wide association study for four measures of epigenetic age acceleration and two epigenetic surrogate markers using DNA methylation data from Taiwan Biobank.
key_loci: IBA57 rs117530284-A +1.59 y GrimEAA || candidates: IBA57:rs117530284:A:1.5943:2e-09
notes: First DNAm-clock GWAS in East Asians; replicated 21 of 137 McCartney loci.

title: A genome-wide association study identifies Asian-specific genetic susceptibility for epigenetic age acceleration.
phenotype_definition: EAA for Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge, Zhang2019, Skin&Blood
key_loci: 6 SNPs (5 novel, rare in Europeans); ASPA/SPATA22 (PhenoAge), ENO2/TPI1 (Zhang2019)
notes: Ancestry-specific clock loci; rsIDs not in abstract.

title: Proteomic aging clock predicts mortality and risk of common age-related diseases in diverse populations.
phenotype_definition: ProtAge (204 Olink proteins) vs chronological age
key_loci: none (clock)
replication_status: validated in CKB and FinnGen subsets
notes: ProtAgeGap predicts 18 chronic diseases, multimorbidity and mortality.

title: Genome-wide association study of proteomic aging reveals shared genetic architectures with longevity, early life development, and age-related diseases
n_controls_or_total: 38,865 (UKB); PGS tested in FinnGen 500,348, All of Us 117,415, CKB 100,640, ABCD 5,204
key_loci: 27 loci; FTO colocalisation (rsIDs not in abstract)
notes: rg with longevity = -0.83; ProtAgeGap PGS OR=1.43 for longevity in FinnGen (direction as reported in abstract).

title: Genetic determinants of proteomic aging.
ancestry: UK Biobank (ancestry not stated in abstract)
key_loci: BRCA1, POLR2A, TET2 (after removing single-pQTL-driven signals; rsIDs not in abstract)
notes: 1 year older proteomic age -> +13% all-cause mortality hazard; rg with epigenetic clocks 0.17-0.19, with LTL -0.2; MR: BMI and T2D accelerate.

title: Organ aging signatures in the plasma proteome track health and disease.
key_loci: none (non-genetic)
notes: ~20% of people have one strongly accelerated organ; 1.7% multi-organ agers; accelerated organ ageing -> 20-50% higher mortality.

title: Plasma proteomics links brain and immune system aging with healthspan and longevity.
key_loci: APOE used as comparator
notes: Aged brain AD HR 3.1 (~one APOE4 copy); youthful brain HR 0.26; 8+ aged organs mortality HR 8.3; youthful brain+immune HR 0.44.

title: Revealing the genetic architectures underlying organ-specific aging based on proteomic data.
ancestry: UK Biobank (ancestry not stated in abstract)
key_loci: 119 loci, 27 shared across organs (rsIDs in supplement; not extracted)
notes: MR: heart/muscle ageing -> heart failure; kidney ageing -> hypertension; smoking initiation -> lung, intestine, kidney, stomach ageing.

title: Heterogeneous aging across multiple organ systems and prediction of chronic disease and mortality.
phenotype_definition: biological age of 3 brain and 7 body systems
key_loci: none
notes: Body age predicts survival (AUC 0.77) and premature death (AUC 0.86).

title: The genetic architecture of biological age in nine human organ systems.
phenotype_definition: biological age gap in 9 organ systems (imaging/physical/physiological)
key_loci: 393 locus-BAG pairs (catalog entries not found)
notes: Mostly organ-specific genetic effects with cross-organ pleiotropy; MR network with sleep and body weight.

title: Multi-omic underpinnings of heterogeneous aging across multiple organ systems.
key_loci: prioritised drug targets (not extracted)
notes: Resource paper (R/Shiny).

title: Genome-wide analysis of brain age identifies 59 associated loci and unveils relationships with mental and physical health.
phenotype_definition: MRI brain age gap (grey, white, combined)
key_loci: 59 loci (39 novel); lead MAPT/KANSL1 17q21.31 inversion region; KLF3 || candidates: MAPT:rs4327091:A:0.44592485:3e-76; KANSL1:rs2260227:T:-0.4834772:9e-83; KLF3:rs13132853:A:-0.26036677:9e-36
notes: SNP h2 23-29%; MR: high BP and T2D cause accelerated brain ageing.

title: The genetic architecture of multimodal human brain age.
ancestry: UK Biobank (ancestry not stated in abstract)
key_loci: 16 loci

title: Genetic architecture of brain age and its causal relations with brain and mental disorders.
ancestry: UK Biobank (ancestry not stated in abstract)
key_loci: 8 regions
notes: MR: AD and bipolar disorder -> BAG.

title: A genome-wide association study of the frailty index highlights brain pathways in ageing.
key_loci: 14 loci (HLA-DQB1, HTT, SYT14, FOXP2, NLGN1, ANK3, ...) || candidates: HLA-DQB1:rs9275160:A:0.0382:7e-28; HTT:rs82334:A:0.0223:3e-10
replication_status: superseded in power by Ye 2023 / Mak 2025
notes: SNP h2 of FI 11%; twin h2 30-45%; MR: education lowers frailty.

title: A genome-wide association study of frailty identifies significant genetic correlation with neuropsychiatric, cardiovascular, and inflammation pathways.
key_loci: 37 loci (catalog entries not found)
replication_status: PRS replicated in HRS: OR 1.27 per SD
notes: MR: chronic pain, obesity, education, depression causally linked.

title: Large-scale genome-wide analyses with proteomics integration reveal novel loci and biological insights into frailty.
key_loci: 53 lead variants (45 novel); APOE rs429358 strongest; CHST9, ILRUN, KHK, MET, CGREF1, PPP6C, SH2B3, FOXP2 (catalog effect alleles not given)
notes: SNP h2 of HFRS ~6%.

title: Ordinal GWAS analysis of the frailty phenotype identified a novel locus at 12q22 that underscores the role of the neurological and immune systems.
ancestry: Canadian (CLSA); ancestry not stated in abstract
key_loci: rs147311617 near PLXNC1 (p=4.98e-8); SOCS2 eQTL (allele not in abstract)

title: Genome-wide association study of frailty and integrative functional analysis to elucidate its relationship with aging.
phenotype_definition: FRAIL scale, CHS index, frailty index
key_loci: 8 suggestive SNPs (P<1e-6), e.g. AKAP12 rs73619247, BANK1 rs118100642
notes: Ancestry-specific, suggestive only.

title: Polygenic basis and biomedical consequences of telomere length variation.
key_loci: 197 sentinel variants at 138 loci (108 new); TERT, TERC, OBFC1/STN1, NAF1 etc. (alleles in supplement)
notes: LTL >1 SD shorter at age 40 -> 2.5-year lower life expectancy vs >=1 SD longer (observational). MR: longer LTL raises some cancers, lowers vascular disease - so TL alleles are NOT simply pro-longevity.

title: Genome-wide Association Analysis in Humans Links Nucleotide Metabolism to Leukocyte Telomere Length.
notes: Used here as allele source for TL leads (GWAS Catalog).

title: Genomic, phenomic and geographic associations of leukocyte telomere length in the United States.
design: WGS-derived LTL GWAS (All of Us) + meta
key_loci: 234 loci (37 novel); 6 loci unique to non-European-like populations, 1 female-specific
notes: Phenomic/genomic heterogeneity across ancestry and sex; geographical clustering of LTL in the US.

title: Genetic predisposition to mosaic Y chromosome loss in blood.
phenotype_definition: mosaic loss of chromosome Y (PAR-LOY) in blood
key_loci: 156 loci; top BCL2 rs17758695, TCL1A rs2887399, TSC22D2 rs59633341 (alleles in supplement)
notes: LOY genetic susceptibility associated with non-haematological outcomes in both sexes.

title: Genetic variants associated with mosaic Y chromosome loss highlight cell cycle genes and overlap with cancer susceptibility.
key_loci: 19 regions (ATM, NPAT, PMF1, TP53, TSC22D2 ...) || candidates: TSC22D2:rs59633341:A:-0.004:4e-28
notes: Used as allele source for TSC22D2 rs59633341 (GWAS Catalog).

title: Multi-ancestry genome-wide association meta-analysis of mosaic loss of chromosome Y in the Million Veteran Program identifies 240 novel loci
key_loci: 380 loci (240 novel); ancestry-specific BCL2L1, SETBP1
notes: mLOY positively associated with smoking.

title: Genetic drivers and cellular selection of female mosaic X chromosome loss.
key_loci: 56 common variants (SP140L, HLA-B top); rare FBXO10 missense ~2-fold risk
notes: Little overlap with mLOY loci.

title: Common and rare variant associations with clonal haematopoiesis phenotypes.
key_loci: 24 CHIP loci (21 novel) incl. LY75 missense; catalog entries lack rsIDs
notes: CHIP associated with all-cause mortality.

title: Nuclear genetic control of mtDNA copy number and heteroplasmy in humans.
ancestry: UK Biobank WGS (ancestry mix not checked)
key_loci: 92 mtCN loci (LONP1, TFAM, NDUFV3, ...); 42 heteroplasmy loci; chrM:302 length variant || candidates: LONP1:rs11085147:C:-0.13704:1e-109; TFAM:rs12247015:A:-0.07441:8e-96; NDUFV3:rs4148974:C:0.10863:5e-48
notes: mtCN declines linearly with age; heteroplasmic SNVs accumulate after age 70. Relevant to the heteroplasmy table kind.

title: Genome-wide analysis of mitochondrial DNA copy number reveals loci implicated in nucleotide metabolism, platelet activation, and megakaryocyte proliferation.
key_loci: 133 SNPs at 100 loci (catalog entries not found)
notes: MR with mtDNA SNPs: mitochondrial function -> overall (p=0.044) and non-cancer mortality.

title: A genome-wide association study of mitochondrial DNA copy number in two population-based cohorts.
key_loci: TFAM replicated (beta 0.046); MED24 rs709591 sub-GWS
notes: Small, early.

title: A genome-wide association study identified 10 novel genomic loci associated with intrinsic capacity.
venue_or_preprint_server: The journals of gerontology. Series A, Biological sciences and medical sciences
ancestry: UK + Canadian cohorts; ancestry not stated in abstract
key_loci: 38 SNPs / 10 loci (MAPT rs9891103 top; catalog lacks effect alleles)

title: Associations and interaction effects of socioeconomic, lifestyle, and genetic factors on intrinsic capacity.
venue_or_preprint_server: The journals of gerontology. Series A, Biological sciences and medical sciences
ancestry: Canadian (CLSA); ancestry not stated in abstract
key_loci: PGS-IC
notes: Small G x E interactions with diet, education, sleep.

title: Integrative GWAS and co-localisation analysis suggests novel genes associated with age-related multimorbidity.
key_loci: 995 shared target genes
notes: Gene-level resource; not a variant source.

title: Genome-wide association study of cardiometabolic multimorbidity in the UK Biobank.
key_loci: 11 loci/12 lead SNPs (TCF7L2, CDKN2B-AS1, LPA) || candidates: TCF7L2:rs34872471:C:0.173769:3e-40
notes: Corroborates TCF7L2/CDKN2B-AS1/LPA as cross-disease "healthspan" loci.

title: Genome-wide association study and pathway analysis of healthy aging in Super Seniors.
phenotype_definition: Super Seniors (>=85y, free of cancer, CVD, diabetes, dementia, major lung disease) vs mid-life controls
ancestry: Canadian; ancestry not stated in abstract
key_loci: APOE4 reduced odds (P=0.0025); FOXO3 rs2802292/rs13217795/rs10457180 nominal; no GWS hits
notes: Healthy-ageing phenotype; female-stronger effects.

title: Novel modelling approaches to elucidate the genetic architecture of resilience to Alzheimer's disease.
key_loci: rs757022 chr17 (P=1.1e-7, sub-GWS)
notes: Cognitive-resilience genetics remains underpowered.

title: Genetic insights into the association of statin and newer nonstatin drug target genes with human longevity: a Mendelian randomization analysis.
key_loci: LDLR, HMGCR, PCSK9, NPC1L1, APOB, CETP, LPL, APOC3, ANGPTL3 instruments
notes: LDLR-mimicking variants extend lifespan (22.8% mediated by CHD); CETP, APOC3 inhibition also; HMGCR, PCSK9, LPL, APOB longer lifespan but not extreme longevity.

title: Causal effects of lipid-lowering therapies on aging-related outcomes and risk of cancers: a drug-target Mendelian randomization study.
key_loci: same 9 lipid targets
notes: PCSK9, CETP, LPL, LDLR, APOC3 lipid-lowering variants associated with longer lifespan.

title: A Mendelian randomization study of IL6 signaling in cardiovascular diseases, immune-related disorders and longevity.
phenotype_definition: parental age at death; CVD; immune disease
key_loci: IL6R cis instruments (sIL6R)
notes: Genetically reduced IL-6 signalling lowers multiple CVDs and associates with longer parental lifespan, at the cost of higher atopic risk.

title: Integrating AI and Causal Genetics to Prioritize Therapeutic Targets for Aging and Age-Related Diseases.
key_loci: IL6, IL6R, NLRP3, NOS2, TLR4, GLP1R
notes: IL6R expression variants colocalise with parental survival.

title: Cardiovascular risk factors and lifestyle behaviours in relation to longevity: a Mendelian randomization study.
key_loci: Life Simple 7 instruments
notes: Per SD BMI OR 0.80; per SD education OR 1.64; SBP OR 0.96 per mmHg; LDL-C OR 0.75 per SD; smoking initiation 0.75; HDL 1.23; T2D liability 0.88.

title: The total and direct effects of systolic and diastolic blood pressure on cardiovascular disease and longevity using Mendelian randomisation.
key_loci: BP instruments
notes: SBP total effect -0.20 parental attained-age z per SD; DBP -0.17.

title: A trans-omic Mendelian randomization study of parental lifespan uncovers novel aging biology and therapeutic candidates for chronic diseases.
key_loci: HP (haptoglobin), apoB-lipoproteins
notes: Liver HP expression and plasma haptoglobin causally linked with parental lifespan.

title: Causal association of education attainment with aging and cardiac death: Evidence from Mendelian randomization analysis.
phenotype_definition: frailty index, GrimAge accel., LTL, cardiac death
key_loci: education instruments
notes: Education -> lower FI (OR 0.846), lower GrimAge accel. (OR 0.523), longer LTL.
